verdict.rationale: Orrick is a law firm whose product surface is a free self-service resource site (Tech Studio forms, document generators, health-check tools) plus client portals, not an AI agent or assistant that could act as an MCP client. Plugging MCP servers in to use their tools is therefore a category error for this product type, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.
